releases.notes:
Filter the cycle's pressure and add the Auto Start refusal reason

On the press with v0.1.1, Auto Start only vibrated the pump: the PWM
ramp-up read as false pressure, so the cycle stopped and restarted the
pump every tick. The cycle now decides on a 90 ms median, with a 0.5 s
minimum on and 0.3 s minimum off time and a hold band of at least 5 psi.
3x0012 reports why the last Auto Start was refused (FD-50).

Fixes the pump current reading and makes a full joystick push drive the pump fully on.

Pump current: the board now measures the motor driver's zero point itself and subtracts it, so the HMI shows about 0 mA with the pump stopped instead of 500-2800 mA. Retract still runs for its maximum time (30 s) until the end-of-retract current is tuned.

Full push: with the joystick pushed all the way, the pump now runs fully on with no switching. Test for the pressure jumping while the pump runs: compare the HMI pressure at a partial push and at a full push, press direction, no load. If the false pressure goes away at a full push, the motor switching is the cause.

Still known: the pressure reads too high while the pump runs. Use the joystick only, not the automatic cycle, until that is solved.

Full firmware for the 4CRP Smart IO Board: heaters, pressure sensor, hydraulic pump, joystick and the automatic pressing cycle (Auto Start with pressure gain, hold top-up, run time, Retract), plus presets and settings that survive a power cycle.

First release with pump control, not yet tested on the press: stay with the press the first time. Check that the pressure reads about 0 psi at rest, that pushing the joystick forward closes the press (if it opens instead, set the pump direction invert setting), and run one short cycle at low pressure before normal use. Heaters are capped at 25 % by default. Retract runs for its maximum time (30 s) until the end-of-retract current is tuned.

Adds temperature control for the three heaters (Chamber, Piston, Filter brace). Each heater switches on and off to hold its setpoint from the HMI (default 200 °F). Power is limited to 25 % by default: a heater is on for at most 2.5 s in every 10 s. The limit can be changed in HMI registers 4x0010–4x0012 and returns to 25 % whenever the board restarts. A heater only runs while it is switched on from the HMI and its temperature sensor reads correctly. It switches off if the sensor fails, if the HMI stops talking to the board for 3 seconds, or when Stop is pressed. Pump and pressure control are not in this release yet, so the press can't run a pressing cycle with it. This is the first release that switches the heaters on: stay with the press the first time you use it.

First firmware release for the 4CRP Smart IO Board. Brings up Ethernet and the Modbus TCP link to the HMI (192.168.1.10) and holds all heaters and the pump off. Heater, pump and sensor control are not in this release yet, so the press can't run a pressing cycle with it.
